opts=[(F(1,6),F(1,3),F(1,2)),(F(1,3),F(1,3),F(1,2)),(F(1,6),F(1,3),F(1,4)),(F(1,2),F(1,2),F(1,3))]

    if sum(t)!=1: return False
    return any(2*t[i]==sum(t)-t[i] for i in range(3))
assert [fits(o) for o in opts]==[True,False,False,False]
